zh-CN.title: 六十件新藏品进入个性化库
items: 聊天背景、聊天气泡与头像框各新增 20 款，并按风格系列重新分组
每套气泡完整覆盖文字、语音、文件、位置、链接与足迹等消息卡片
头像框加入挂件、材质与动态效果，系统减少动态时会自动静止

en.title: Sixty new pieces join the personalization library
items: Chat backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames each gain 20 new designs grouped into clear collections
Every bubble skin now covers text, audio, files, locations, links, travel maps, and other message cards
Avatar frames introduce distinct ornaments, materials, and motion that respects reduced-motion preferences
